data.description: The Leg Press Cum Parallel Bar pairs a seated leg press with a set of parallel bars. On the leg press, the user sits and pushes the footplates away to work the thighs and hips. On the parallel bars, stronger users do dips and supported leg raises, while older users can hold them for balance during stretches. That spread of uses makes it a good single purchase for a school, college or society gym. Our Fun Fitness listing gives it in Play Orange. The parallel bars carry full body weight during dips, so the frame is best grouted. The leg press seat swings on pivots that need regular checks. Lay rubber flooring under the bars, where users step down, and keep the bars free of rust spots and loose fittings.
